summary.title: PostgreSQL Exercises
summary.one_liner: Learn SQL by doing, through graded PostgreSQL practice questions built on one simple dataset, from basic SELECT and WHERE up to joins, aggregations, window functions and recursive queries.
takeaways: Practice SQL through a series of questions with explanations.
Progress from simple SELECT and WHERE clauses to joins and CASE statements.
Move on to aggregations, window functions and recursive queries.
Start with the Getting Started page to learn the single shared dataset.
Intended as a companion to a SQL book or the official Postgres documentation.
summary.summary: PGExercises is a free site of SQL exercises for PostgreSQL, written by its author because there was little material for learning SQL by practice. All exercises use one simple dataset, introduced on a Getting Started page. Categories are selected from the menu and range from basic select and where clauses through joins, case statements, aggregations, window functions and recursive queries. The site is meant to be used alongside a good book or the Postgres documentation, and its content is licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0.
